verdict: The exact 31-path local candidate was independently hash-verified (zero mismatches). All seven discovery modules were read through public command paths. Descriptor-relative retained checkout/input/store/package-resource reads, complete first-absence sets, nonblocking checkout locking, atomic installation identity, bound resource snapshots, and final safety verification cover status, initialization, planning, observation, assessment, controls, decisions, handoff and rendering. No new I/O, egress, Vault, or path-lineage blocker was found in this review.
scope: Read-only review of the frozen local discovery candidate and all public discovery I/O paths. No source, test, Git, network, connector, real Vault, or human gate was mutated; only this review artifact was written.

review_points.evidence: open_store captures every discovery schema/profile/prompt through RetainedTree.file, validates them inside bound_resources, and verifies the retained tree on normal and exceptional exits. context uses only the bound snapshot; handoff retains every preview schema through the same tree and verifies before returning.

RetainedTree records missing named edges and complete directory sets before parsing or installation. DiscoveryStore.scan observes root/family sets and all fixed family slots; ensure_layout creates only after preflight and rejects foreign post-absence occupants.

checked_path rejects aliases, traversal, control characters, non-NFC and unsafe spelling; descriptor-relative file reads reject symlink/hardlink/nonregular inputs and retain bytes/identity through final verification.

open_store acquires the checkout flock before the first .work observation and retains a duplicate checkout descriptor until after tree.close; prior R2 cleanup contention probe and boundary test preserve DISCOVERY_BUSY without creating work state.

init/status/plan/observe/finish/resume/control/decide/handoff/context/render all run under open_store; handoff is data-only and does not create preview/Vault output, while render escapes candidate text.

The reviewed modules contain no subprocess, socket, HTTP client, Vault, or arbitrary output writes. Public boundary test patches network/process execution and verifies the protected Vault sentinel remains unchanged.

deferred_gates: Run exact installed-wheel/resource and CLI parity checks against this candidate as the parent delivery gate.
Run fresh four-job remote CI against the exact candidate head/base; local test results are not remote CI evidence.
Provider capability, real-data, Vault/admin and human scientific gates remain outside this I/O review.
